hero.title: Got limescale at home? Put an end to it!
hero.subtitle: Water in Israel is hard, and its calcium builds up as limescale in pipes, boilers and appliances. A combined main filter at your home's water inlet prevents scale buildup by up to 85% and filters sand, rust and dirt down to 50 microns, with full installation and a free check valve.
hero.imageAlt: Slofos filtration systems: a two-stage main filtration system and a combined main filter with a stainless-steel mesh cartridge

ruler.title: 50 microns is finer than a hair.
ruler.text: A human hair is about 70 microns thick. The mesh stops anything larger than 50.

video.title: Limescale: the problem and the fix
video.sub: A short video: where limescale comes from, how it damages your boiler and washing machine, and how the combined main filter protects your home.

about.title: A.M Filters — scale-prevention specialists
about.body: At A.M Filters we specialize in water treatment and scale prevention for homes and businesses. We supply and install whole-home filtration systems, water-pressure regulators and check valves, and provide professional faucet replacement — all with personal service, expertise and reliability. Our goal is simple: clean, healthy water and plumbing protected from scale, for years to come.
